description:
Activate Lavabrink Floodgates by tapping it, adding {R}{R}.
Activate Voltaic Key by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting Lavabrink Floodgates.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying Voltaic Key's ability, targeting Voltaic Key.
Resolve both Voltaic Key abilities, untapping it and Lavabrink Floodgates.
Repeat.
